title: Configure primary and secondary selection objectives across native flywheel stages

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented provider-neutral SelectionPolicy: primary/secondary accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and probability metrics; explicit positive class or macro aggregation; secondary no-regression default and optional floor. Wired runtime, staged rubric/refinement, example swaps and ML selection including raw-decision candidate. Persisted restart policy and policy-aware selection caches; unchanged request cache survives objective changes. Trace inspector exposes objective scores/reasons. Reviewer/replay CLI and README documented. 552 offline tests pass; no live model requests or changes to prior replay results.
